summary: Master and current hand sizes include manor draw upgrades and inherited draw traits.
Register character HEIR and identical HEIR_COLOR names for card color and card library enums; provide the host red energy flash texture when using EnergyOrbRed.
Random first heir; later choose one of three, each with two distinct traits.
Earn 2 crowns per cleared floor; remaining gold converts at 25:1. Combined bonuses are capped at +100%.
Victory adds 20 crowns. Each run settles at most once.
First run skips Neow and enters a normal floor-one fight once GAMEPLAY initialization and its fade-in are complete.
Family Manor and Heir Settings are contextual options beneath The Heir on character selection; preserve between-run choices, upgrades and family identity.
Require Rogue Legacy 2; read genuine class and trait sprites into a local cache at launch.
Atomic profile saves, backup recovery, and a unique run identity.

Hover a trait icon or name in combat or on an heir offer to see its sheet-derived maximum HP, Strength, Dexterity, draw, healing, legacy earnings and cosmetic size changes. Render above the manor; clamp to screen.
Each card loads its own effect-based original illustration from the card_art sheet and packaged resources; retain Rogue Legacy 2 class/trait content on the character, HUD and heir offers.
Render the native game cursor after manor panels and trait tooltips so upgrade controls remain usable.
Convert 25 unspent run gold into one legacy crown.
Temporary pre-release crown editor. Explicit Save validates a nonnegative whole number. Remove for the full release.
